_comment: p90 of the in-container wall time (s) per template and GPU family: base_s + per_unit_s x units (ab: switches; gate: gates = switches + 1; profile: 1). The launcher sets the command timeout to twice this, rounded up to a minute (resource framework 3.5). Fitted on 7 November 2026 from the modal.json of 130 hopper_sweep A/B and 6 const_gate jobs under WSL ~/fm-runs (H200: 1 switch p90 ~210 s, 3 ~575 s, 5 ~790 s, 12 ~1570 s; A100: 1 switch p90 ~300 s, 2 ~510 s, 3 ~560 s, 5 ~920 s; gates of 2: H200 ~600 s, A100 ~750 s). profile has no Modal data yet: a guess, refit after the first runs.
